oracle_provenance: GUM (Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement) combined/expanded uncertainty formulas, standard textbook metrology; independently hand-verified before implementation. Not copied from any shared Skill fixture.
scope: Bounded combined and expanded measurement uncertainty from declared independent standard-uncertainty components; not an empirically validated gage R&R study.

cases.question: Does a modest set of uncertainty components combine to an expanded uncertainty within the declared budget?
When larger uncertainty components push the expanded uncertainty above the declared budget, is that flagged rather than silently accepted?
Must an empty uncertainty-component list be rejected rather than silently treated as zero uncertainty?
Does RSS combination of the same components stay strictly below their arithmetic sum, the model's own self-consistency guarantee for more than one nonzero component?
